title: 第13章 镇灵音乐盒第14章 苦境武盟
content_zh:
李青山手上，有王孝的身份甲牌。
牌子上有地址。
“永兴坊桥街西巷五里二甲五号...”
李青山看了眼街道入口那明显高级许多的坊市牌楼，打量了好一会。
“我好像对王孝有点误会...”
他收回目光，朝坊市里面走去。
县城的坊，就类似他前世的某某社区街道办。
坊里面的街、巷这些，就类似不同的小区楼盘。
坊市和坊市、街巷之间，可能还存在一些牌楼门坊之类，晚上的时候会封住，不让外人随意通行。
王孝居住的永兴坊，明显属于县城的高档生活区。
这里基本是一座座的府邸。
往来行走的路人，也比李青山看过的其他坊市行人穿着、气色之类，好上许多。
经过不断询问路人。
李青山走了差不多半小时，才找到王孝的住处。
...
王孝的住处看着不起眼。
小门小院，墙高不过三米，被左邻右舍的五米青砖墙垣连绵，灰瓦翘檐居高临下包裹，显得有些小巧精致。
唯一的不同，便是府门前立着两个不知名凶兽石雕，张牙舞爪，利爪嘴唇染了暗红色颜料，给人一种凶戾之感。
李青山打量了两眼石雕，上前抓住铜环敲了敲。
等待片刻。

府门从内拉开，探出个小脑袋。
这是个八九岁的小娃娃，虎头虎脑，皮肤黝黑，一双眼睛大得出奇，滴溜溜看着李青山。
小娃娃不说话，就这样默默看着他。
李青山心中居然莫名有些心慌。
他下意识后退半步，弯着腰，脸上露出和善笑容：“在下李青山，来找王孝王教习。”
说着，他亮了亮王孝给他的甲牌。
见着甲牌，小娃娃才收回打量的目光，打开半边门，让出身位，发出苍老的声线：“王小子出去买东西了，马上回来。”
李青山惊疑地看向对方，以为自己听错了。
这声音，对吗？
见了他这模样，小娃娃一双大眼翻了个白眼：“镇灵都不知道，真是个土鳖，自己进去等。”
话音落下。
对方整个身形，竟是化作点点血色光辉，融入了眼前的大门之中。
与此同时。
那对凶兽雕像的眼珠，也多了些灵性。
李青山：...
这世界他是越来越看不明白了。
...
进了府。
府门自己就关上了。
李青山深吸一口气，压下心中杂念，打量起府内布置。

府内和外边一般简朴。
入门便是一方青石小天井，地面却是那种泛着硬实的黄土地面，院中立着个坑坑洼洼的铜人桩，屋前空地开阔平整，放着石桌石椅。
“咦~”
李青山将目光停在石桌上面的东西上面。
content_en:
Li Qingshan has Wang Xiao's identity card in his hand.
There's an address on the sign.
"No. 5, Wuli Erjia, West Lane, Fangqiao Street, Yongxing..."
Li Qingshan glanced at the obviously much more advanced Fangshi archway at the entrance of the street and looked at it for a long time.
"I seem to have some misunderstandings about Wang Xiao..."
He withdrew his gaze and walked towards Fangshi.
The county square is similar to the certain community street office in his previous life.
The streets and alleys inside the square are similar to different residential properties.
There may be some archways and gates between the cities and streets, which will be sealed at night to prevent outsiders from passing through at will.
Yongxingfang, where Wang Xiao lives, is obviously a high-end living area in the county.
There are basically mansions here.
The passers-by walking around were also much better dressed and looked better than the other pedestrians Li Qingshan had seen.
After constantly asking passers-by.
Li Qingshan walked for almost half an hour before finding Wang Xiao's residence.
...
Wang Xiao's residence looks inconspicuous.
The walls of the small courtyard with a small gate are only three meters high. It is surrounded by the five-meter green brick walls of the neighboring buildings and the gray tiles with raised eaves are condescending. It looks a bit small and exquisite.
The only difference is that there are two unknown stone sculptures of ferocious beasts standing in front of the house, with their teeth and claws spread out, and their sharp claws and lips dyed with dark red paint, giving people a ferocious feeling.
Li Qingshan looked at the stone sculpture, stepped forward, grabbed the copper ring and knocked it.
Wait a moment.
The door of the mansion was opened from the inside, and a little head poked out.
This is a little boy of eight or nine years old, with a tiger-like head, dark skin, and a pair of surprisingly big eyes, looking at Li Qingshan.
The little baby didn't speak, just looked at him silently.
Li Qingshan felt a little flustered for no reason.
He subconsciously took half a step back, bent down, and said with a kind smile on his face: "Li Qingshan, I'm here to come to Wang Xiaowang to teach me."
As he spoke, he showed the A card given to him by Wang Xiao.
Seeing the A card, the little doll stopped looking at it, opened half of the door, stepped out of the room, and said in an old voice: "Boy Wang went out to buy things, and will be back soon."
Li Qingshan looked at the other party in surprise, thinking that he heard wrongly.
This sound, right?
Seeing his appearance, the little boy rolled his big eyes and said, "The town spirit doesn't even know. He's such a country bumpkin. Go in and wait by yourself."
The words fell.
The opponent's entire figure turned into dots of blood-colored light and merged into the door in front of him.
at the same time.
The eyes of the ferocious beast statue are also more spiritual.
Li Qingshan:...
This world is becoming increasingly unclear to him.
...
Entered the house.
The door of the mansion closed itself.
Li Qingshan took a deep breath, suppressed the distracting thoughts in his heart, and looked at the layout of the house.
The interior and exterior of the mansion are generally simple.
There is a small bluestone patio at the entrance, but the ground is the kind of hard loess. There is a bumpy copper man stake in the courtyard. The open space in front of the house is open and flat, with stone tables and chairs.
"Eh~"
Li Qingshan stopped his eyes on the things on the stone table.
